title: Isolation of Klebsiella Strains from Fecal Material
author: Sylvain Brisse
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.662hhge

steps.title: Pre-treat and enrich fecal sample
steps.instruction: Enrich the fecal sample using an enrichment broth to select for Klebsiella isolates.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 10 mL of Luria-Bertani (LB) broth or Trypto-Casein Soy broth (TSB) supplemented with ampicillin to a final concentration of 10 mg/L.
Inoculate the broth with a swab or a loopful (10 μL) of fecal material and mix.
Incubate at 37 °C ± 1°C for 24 h ± 1 h (18 hours is also acceptable, provided all samples are treated consistently).

steps.title: Streak onto SCAi medium
steps.instruction: Isolate single colonies by streaking the enriched sample onto SCAi medium agar plates.

substeps.instruction: Using a 10 μL loop, streak the sample onto a SCAi medium Petri dish (e.g., 90 mm).
Incubate the plate at 37°C ± 1°C for 48 h ± 1 h (note: while colonies may appear after 24h, 48h is preferred for better discrimination from E. coli).

steps.title: Purify suspect Klebsiella pneumoniae colonies
steps.instruction: Select and purify typical yellow, moist, dome-shaped Klebsiella colonies from the SCAi plates.

substeps.instruction: Pick suspect yellow colonies for subculture.
If colonies are too numerous or close together, re-isolate the colony on another SCAi agar plate to ensure purity.

steps.title: Store mixed-colony plates (Optional)
steps.instruction: Preserve the remaining SCAi plate content for future studies, such as mixed colonies sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Sweep the remaining content of the SCAi plate.
Freeze at -80°C using CryoBank tubes or equivalent (e.g., in-house BHI + 15% glycerol medium).

steps.title: Identify purified colonies
steps.instruction: Confirm the species of the purified suspect colonies.

substeps.instruction: Streak selected colonies onto a non-selective agar medium (e.g., LB or TSA) to allow isolated colonies to develop.
Incubate plates at 37 °C ± 1°C for 24 h ± 1 h.
Determine the species using MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry and/or species-specific PCR.

steps.title: Store confirmed bacterial strains
steps.instruction: Long-term storage of confirmed Klebsiella pneumoniae or related species.

substeps.instruction: Freeze confirmed strains at -80°C using CryoBank tubes or equivalent (e.g., BHI + 15% glycerol medium).
If multiple morphotypes are present, store one colony per morphotype.
